items.claim: McVey has developed in a much better way since his and Schultz's previous fight on the amateur circuit.
items.quote: McVey has just developed in a much better way.

items.claim: McVey will put big damage on Schultz in the clinch using elbows and knees.
items.quote: McVey is going to put big damage on Schultz in the clinch, elbows, knees.

items.claim: Elise Reed has a historical pattern of winning one fight and then losing one fight.
items.quote: Historically speaking, Elise Reed wins one, loses one. Wins one, loses one.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer is the much better striker compared to Elise Reed.
items.quote: Dyer is the much better striker.

items.claim: Carl Fro has fight-changing power, whereas Elise Reed does not.
items.quote: Carl Fro has that fight changing power, and we simply cannot say the same thing about Elise Reed.

items.claim: Gregory Rodriguez possesses one-hitter quitter knockout power.
items.quote: Hobocop with that one hitter quitter.
